operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to enter the European market in 2025.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, got a sec? I was just reviewing the Q3 targets and something feels off.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sure, I've got a few minutes. What's on your mind?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Remember we were supposed to enter Europe this year? Earlier I had planned 2025 for the market entry, but we've shifted to 2026. Just want to make sure you're aligned.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it, yeah, I recall the timeline moved. What triggered the shift?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly the distribution setup. We're pairing it with a German partnership, and the CFO is still finalizing the European P&L. It made sense to give it a bit more runway.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. A solid partnership is worth waiting for. How's the CFO feeling about the numbers?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: She's confident, actually. It's just the usual back-and-forth on overhead allocations. No big drama.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good to hear. So we're tracking for a 2026 launch regardless of the initial 2025 idea?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. We're committed to 2026 now. The 2025 plan is just a stale memory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. I'll make sure the team knows. Anything else you need?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier plan to enter Europe in 2025; retain the current 2026 plan and the rest of the details.
